identification: Mahogany brass-bound campaign style trunk, flush brass corner and side straps, oval brass plate, escutcheon. Heavy wear, old finish, one photo. Probably late 19th or early 20th century; no maker marks visible. Dimensions about 90cm wide.

entries.note: CAMPAIGN TRUNK - CIRCA 1863, 2 bids. Local database record (premium extra); wood and condition not checked, so only a loose guide.
Generic timber, camphorwood and lift-top trunks; 40 trunks since Oct 2025 with median $180, range $105-$620. Not campaign style, so a floor guide only.

searches_tried: comps.py (both) for campaign trunk, brass bound, camphor trunk, trunk; Gowans API search campaign; WebSearch for Australian sold campaign trunks and Armitage site search (no Australian results; only UK/US/ZA retail and one US $400 Anglo-Indian mahogany campaign chest snippet, not used). eBay sold would help: needs_chrome.

viewing_check: Check whether it is true mahogany with flush brass fittings or a later veneer or stained pine, a maker plate or stencil, interior fit (tray, lining), lock and handles, and structural splits or restoration.
